title: Punt AST: Player Targets
markdown:
**Summary.** The punt AST target list in our notes is very thin: three players, all priced at 1 to 2 USD near or past the 144-player cutoff. Maluach gives cheap blocks, Eason gives steals, and Nesmith is a 1 USD bet that his FG% comes back. The notes give no 3PTM or FT% data for any of them, so you have to cover those categories elsewhere. Assists are scarce late in drafts and very hard to find on waivers, so decide on this punt before the auction, not halfway through it.

## What punting assists costs you

Low-assist players often struggle in threes, steals and FT%. If you punt AST, check those three categories on your roster after every few auction wins. There is one built-in gain: punting assists brings your turnovers down, so TO becomes a category you should win most weeks. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

In our 9-cat H2H format, giving up AST means you need to win 5 of the other 8 categories each week. If 3PTM, ST and FT% all slip as well, that path closes fast. So treat those three as the categories your punt AST roster must protect. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

## The list is thin

Only three players in our data carry a punt AST tag: Khaman Maluach, Tari Eason and Aaron Nesmith. All three are 1 to 2 USD end-of-auction picks. Nesmith may not even be drafted in a 144-player pool. None of them is a core early buy, so they will not build a punt AST roster on their own. Your early, expensive picks have to set the direction. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344), [Tari Eason](#player/156), [Aaron Nesmith](#player/412))

The notes give no 3PTM or FT% data for any of the three. Only Eason comes with a clear steals case. Do not count on these picks to fix threes or free throws. Get those from players you buy earlier in the auction. ([Tari Eason](#player/156), [09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630))

Assists are also very hard to find on waivers, and big assist players are rare late in drafts. That cuts both ways. If you punt AST, you will not be able to fix the category later with FAB. If you decide halfway through the draft to stop punting, the assist guys will already be gone. ([07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1073), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=799))

## Where the experts disagree

The notes split on when to commit. One view says points, assists and FT% are the scarcest categories later in drafts, so if you miss them early you can just punt them. The other view says points and assists are very hard to find in good volume late, so secure them early, and it warns that drafting a low-assist player early can leave you behind in assists. In practice: if you want to compete in AST, spend on assists in the first big nominations on 2026-10-18. If you are not willing to do that, commit to the punt from the start, and do not drift into it by accident. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=1822), [09-07](https://youtu.be/E-KmhvyZ2CU?t=799), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1284))

## What each target gives

Khaman Maluach is a cheap blocks source with rebounds and FG%. Phoenix's 4-4-4 playoff schedule adds late value. He offers nothing noted in 3PTM, ST or FT%. In the first weeks, check whether he starts at center and plays about 24 minutes. If Ighodaro keeps the job and Maluach stays near 16 minutes, drop him. ([Khaman Maluach](#player/344))

Tari Eason is the only target with a stated steals case. He also adds rebounds, and he has upside if Durant or Jabari Smith gets hurt. His FG% of 41.6 is a risk. Early on, check whether it recovers and whether Houston really cuts Durant's minutes. If neither happens, drop him for a waiver pickup. Houston's 10-game playoff schedule is one more reason not to hold him long. ([Tari Eason](#player/156))

Aaron Nesmith is a 1 USD last pick or a waiver watch. Experts value him around picks 160 to 168, just outside our pool. Check his hamstring early. Check whether his FG% climbs back toward 48 to 50 percent next to Haliburton, and whether he keeps his starting job over Oubre. If both go his way, he has top 100 upside. ([Aaron Nesmith](#player/412))

## How to run it in our auction

Before 2026-10-18, decide whether you punt AST. If yes, spend your large budget on players who cover 3PTM, ST and FT%, because these targets will not. Save 1 to 2 USD per slot for Maluach and Eason in the final rounds. Leave Nesmith for 1 USD or for waivers. In the first two weeks, use your 6 weekly acquisitions to replace any of them who fail the minutes or FG% checks above. Do not try to buy assists back on waivers, because they are not there. ([09-23](https://youtu.be/C4vlgpJ62NI?t=630), [07-07](https://youtu.be/ME-r173X5b0?t=1073), [Khaman Maluach](#player/344), [Tari Eason](#player/156), [Aaron Nesmith](#player/412))
